info.title: Portal API
info.summary: Self-hosted hackathon submission and judging portal.
info.description: Every screen in the portal is a call to this API. Authenticate with the `portal_session` cookie (set by `/v1/auth/login`), `Authorization: Bearer <session token>`, or `X-API-Key` for integrations. Event paths accept a UUID or the event slug, e.g. `/v1/events/sample-hack-2026`. Role isolation is enforced here, not in the UI: judges read only their own scores, participants and visitors read none. See docs/API.md.
